chapters.title: Still is pink, Animated is blue

transcript.text: Welcome to PNG Font Studio. Let’s take a quick tour of the workspace.
Up top, Titles is where you design and animate. Fonts is where you make the letters themselves.
Undo and redo sit next to them. Every change can be undone.
Still makes images. Animated makes videos. The interface colour tells you which one you’re in.
In Still, the interface turns pink.
In Animated, it turns blue, and a player appears under the stage.
On the left are your layers, the artboard size, and your title files.
On the right, the inspector edits whatever you select: text, alignment, effects, warp, animation, and the layer.
Every divider between panels can be dragged. Make a panel wider or narrower to suit your screen.
The toolbar over the stage holds the tools and the view controls.
Select and move, add text, and pan around.
Zoom out, zoom in, and fit the artboard to the window.
Show the text guides while you type, and the title-safe frame that keeps titles clear of the screen edge.
And the preview background, to see your title on dark, light, or a colour of your own. It’s for viewing only, never exported.
The app speaks English and Hebrew. Switch here, and the whole layout mirrors for right to left.
Switch back to English the same way.
This button switches between dark and light.
Help opens a short guided tour, and every keyboard shortcut. You can also press the question mark key at any time.
That’s the workspace. Next, let’s make a font.
